derivation_scope: Restricted to the publishable corpus of the agent specification.
excluded_sources_statement: No non-publishable, confidential, or provenance source was used for lexical derivation or traceability.

entries.definition_short: Agent ID assigned to the Audit Replay Agent.
entries.definition_operational: Stable identifier that binds the machine-readable and narrative package to the named public agent.
source_refs: Audit Replay Agent — Specification title block
usage_constraints: Use as the agent_id value in machine-readable handoff.

entries.definition_short: Canonical audit / replay / verification agent defined by the public specification.
entries.definition_operational: Agent identity used for offline reconstruction, continuity verification, and reproduction of rollback sequences for ledger-backed sessions.
usage_constraints: Use as the display name of the publishable agent, not as a software implementation label.

entries.definition_short: Critical block state in the workflow and gate logic.
entries.definition_operational: Critical state entered on signature failure, chain break, canonical parse failure, or invalid policy. Permits only incident output and no positive verdict or compliant finalization.
usage_constraints: Use as a fail-closed workflow and gate status, not as a positive audit outcome.

entries.definition_short: Bundle received but not yet validated.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow state entered when input contract satisfied. and exited on ev_parse_ok or structural failure.
usage_constraints: Use as a workflow state in the state transition model.

entries.definition_short: Framing, checksum, and canonical parse are valid.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow state entered when v-01 through v-03 pass. and exited on signature, continuity, and policy verification.
usage_constraints: Use as a workflow state in the state transition model.

entries.definition_short: Signatures, hash continuity, policy binding, and freshness anchors are validated to the extent required by policy.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow state entered when v-04 through v-06 pass; v-09 passes when policy activates freshness or anchor control. and exited on state reconstruction.
usage_constraints: Use as a workflow state in the state transition model.

entries.definition_short: Session state, statement lineage, and record lineage are reconstructed offline.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow state entered when replay fold complete. and exited on checkpoint analysis.
usage_constraints: Use as a workflow state in the state transition model.

entries.definition_short: LASTCLEAN and rollback lineage are identified and evaluated.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow state entered when checkpoint lineage valid. and exited on report assembly or fail-closed / hold.
usage_constraints: Use as a workflow state in the state transition model.

entries.definition_short: A finalizable report and complete machine-readable export are available.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow state entered when evidence sufficiency passes and report sufficiency passes. and exited on emit output.
usage_constraints: Use as a workflow state in the state transition model.

entries.definition_short: Session state for controlled resumption after restored compliance prerequisites.
entries.definition_operational: Readmitted session state permitted only after explicit proof of restored compliance prerequisites, including hold-exit evidence and an updated anchor.
usage_constraints: Use only after readmission prerequisites are satisfied.

entries.definition_short: Session is in audit-only mode after evidence failure, missing verification evidence, or counter / anchor replay.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow state entered when ev_evidence_fail or ev_counter_replay. and exited on ev_readmission_granted or incident-only closure.
usage_constraints: Use as a workflow state in the state transition model.

entries.definition_short: hash_prev / hash_curr no longer form a continuous chain.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Forces verdict BROKEN and SX FAIL_CLOSED.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: The verification counter or freshness anchor is not strictly increasing.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Forces SH HOLD_ACTIVE and blocks compliant finalization.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: Required verification evidence is missing, invalid, or not recognized by policy.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Forces SH HOLD_ACTIVE and blocks compliant finalization.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: A usable checkpoint has been identified.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Permits S3 -> S4.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: All frames can be read deterministically.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Permits S0 -> S1.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: policy_profile_id or policy_hash is not resolvable or not admitted.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Blocks compliant finalization and may force SX.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: There is explicit proof that compliance prerequisites were restored, including hold-exit evidence, resolvable policy, and a strictly increasing updated anchor.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Permits readmission and controlled resumption.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: The report includes continuity, decisions, checkpoints, limitations, and evidence linkage.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Permits S4 -> S5.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: A valid rollback chain has been reproduced offline.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Supports verdict REPLAYABLE.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: A required signature is invalid or missing.
entries.definition_operational: Workflow event. Normative effect: Forces SX FAIL_CLOSED.
usage_constraints: Use as an event in the workflow and state transition model.

entries.definition_short: Rollback control point and reversion path used in offline replay.
entries.definition_operational: Valid only if CHECKPOINT(LASTCLEAN) precedes FAIL_CLOSED and the checkpoint state_hash verifies under the applicable verification ruleset.
usage_constraints: Use only for rollback lineage and replay conditions admitted by the specification.

entries.definition_short: Decision object classified as finalization eligibility.
entries.definition_operational: Primary decision object in the audit vocabulary. Admitted verdicts: FINALIZABLE | INCIDENT_ONLY | BLOCKED. Primary artifact linkage: Decision Table.
usage_constraints: Use with the admitted verdict set defined for Audit report in §5.

entries.definition_short: Admitted blocking state for compliant finalization or report eligibility.
entries.definition_operational: Used where policy binding, report sufficiency, or other critical conditions prevent compliant finalization or prevent a positive report status.
usage_constraints: Use for blocking outcomes that prevent compliant finalization.

entries.definition_short: The integrity chain is not continuous; conclusions about the full history are invalid.
entries.definition_operational: Normative verdict meaning from the semantic contract: The integrity chain is not continuous; conclusions about the full history are invalid.
usage_constraints: Use only with the decision object or gate context that admits this verdict.

entries.definition_short: Decision object classified as checkpoint usability.
entries.definition_operational: Primary decision object in the audit vocabulary. Admitted verdicts: USABLE | STALE | UNVERIFIED. Primary artifact linkage: Workflow / State Transition.
usage_constraints: Use with the admitted verdict set defined for CHECKPOINT(LASTCLEAN) in §5.

entries.definition_short: Admitted finalization eligibility state for the audit report.
entries.definition_operational: Admitted value in the audit report decision-object vocabulary indicating that report finalization is eligible under the decision table and report sufficiency conditions.
usage_constraints: Use only as an admitted audit report eligibility value.

entries.definition_short: Decision object classified as record admission.
entries.definition_operational: Primary decision object in the audit vocabulary. Admitted verdicts: VALID | MALFORMED | UNSUPPORTED. Primary artifact linkage: Validator Catalogue.
usage_constraints: Use with the admitted verdict set defined for Framed record in §5.

entries.definition_short: Decision object classified as integrity gate.
entries.definition_operational: Primary decision object in the audit vocabulary. Admitted verdicts: CONTIGUOUS | BROKEN. Primary artifact linkage: Evidence Contract.
usage_constraints: Use with the admitted verdict set defined for Hash chain continuity in §5.

entries.definition_short: Only incident and remediation artifacts are permitted, not a compliant report.
entries.definition_operational: Normative verdict meaning from the semantic contract: Only incident and remediation artifacts are permitted, not a compliant report.
usage_constraints: Use only with the decision object or gate context that admits this verdict.

entries.definition_short: Decision object classified as admit or reject reconstruction.
entries.definition_operational: Primary decision object in the audit vocabulary. Admitted verdicts: RECONSTRUCTABLE | PARTIAL | REJECTED. Primary artifact linkage: REPORT.
usage_constraints: Use with the admitted verdict set defined for Ledger session in §5.

entries.definition_short: Some artifacts can be reconstructed, but closure is missing for at least one critical decision object.
entries.definition_operational: Normative verdict meaning from the semantic contract: Some artifacts can be reconstructed, but closure is missing for at least one critical decision object.
usage_constraints: Use only with the decision object or gate context that admits this verdict.

entries.definition_short: The input cannot support admissible reconstruction; no compliance output may be issued.
entries.definition_operational: Normative verdict meaning from the semantic contract: The input cannot support admissible reconstruction; no compliance output may be issued.
usage_constraints: Use only with the decision object or gate context that admits this verdict.

entries.definition_short: The session can be reconstructed offline with a decision path, continuity, and rollback lineage sufficient for independent audit.
entries.definition_operational: Normative verdict meaning from the semantic contract: The session can be reconstructed offline with a decision path, continuity, and rollback lineage sufficient for independent audit.
usage_constraints: Use only with the decision object or gate context that admits this verdict.

entries.definition_short: Decision object classified as rollback correctness.
entries.definition_operational: Primary decision object in the audit vocabulary. Admitted verdicts: REPLAYABLE | INCOMPLETE | INVALID. Primary artifact linkage: Gate Logic.
usage_constraints: Use with the admitted verdict set defined for Rollback sequence in §5.

entries.definition_short: Structural validator.
entries.definition_operational: Canonical parse validator (V-03). Pass condition: The canonical serialization can be parsed without ambiguity. Fail effect: Record UNSUPPORTED or MALFORMED; block.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Behavioral validator.
entries.definition_operational: Checkpoint lineage validator (V-07). Pass condition: LASTCLEAN precedes FAIL_CLOSED and its state_hash is verifiable. Fail effect: Rollback INVALID.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Structural validator.
entries.definition_operational: Checksum validator (V-02). Pass condition: The checksum over the canonical bytes is correct. Fail effect: Record MALFORMED; block.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Structural validator.
entries.definition_operational: Frame length validator (V-01). Pass condition: The declared length matches the available bytes. Fail effect: Record MALFORMED; block.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Evidence validator.
entries.definition_operational: Hash continuity validator (V-05). Pass condition: hash_prev and hash_curr form a continuous chain. Fail effect: Verdict BROKEN; FAIL_CLOSED.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Boundary validator.
entries.definition_operational: Policy bind validator (V-06). Pass condition: policy_profile_id and policy_hash are resolvable and admitted. Fail effect: BLOCKED.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Ordering validator.
entries.definition_operational: Replay counter / freshness validator (V-09). Pass condition: The counter or anchor is strictly increasing under policy. Fail effect: NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD / block.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Evidence validator.
entries.definition_operational: Report sufficiency validator (V-08). Pass condition: The report includes decisions, checkpoints, continuity, and limitations. Fail effect: FINALIZE_REPORT blocked.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Evidence validator.
entries.definition_operational: Signature validator (V-04). Pass condition: All required signatures are valid under the current policy. Fail effect: FAIL_CLOSED.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Operational validator.
entries.definition_operational: Tool-state exclusion validator (V-10). Pass condition: No unauthorized tool-state artifact enters logical reconstruction. Fail effect: QUARANTINE.
usage_constraints: Use with the exact pass condition and fail effect defined in the validator catalogue.

entries.definition_short: Proves strict increase after a hold.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes for readmission and counter-sensitive profiles. Purpose: Proves strict increase after a hold.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Contracted package with required fields: report_id; session_id; verdict; continuity summary; checkpoints; rollback refs; limitations; signature / export refs
entries.definition_operational: Contract rule: Must be sufficient for offline audit.
usage_constraints: Use as an input or output contract exactly as listed in §7.

entries.definition_short: Links the verdict to the external evidence chain when policy requires it.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes when policy activates bound verification. Purpose: Links the verdict to the external evidence chain when policy requires it.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Binds the verdict to the exact input bundle.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes. Purpose: Binds the verdict to the exact input bundle.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Proves the clean state used for replay.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes for checkpoint, rollback, or replay verdicts. Purpose: Proves the clean state used for replay.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Proves append-only history and reconstructable ordering.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes. Purpose: Proves append-only history and reconstructable ordering.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Proves entry into audit-only mode.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes when NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD exists. Purpose: Proves entry into audit-only mode.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Proves restoration of compliance prerequisites.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes for readmission. Purpose: Proves restoration of compliance prerequisites.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Contracted package with required fields: reason_code; blocked_stage; inhibitions; required_remediation
entries.definition_operational: Contract rule: The only permitted output in FAIL_CLOSED.
usage_constraints: Use as an input or output contract exactly as listed in §7.

entries.definition_short: Contracted package with required fields: Normalized JSON verdict; validator outcomes; record anomalies; graph of refs
entries.definition_operational: Contract rule: No long-form narrative is required for the execution consumer.
usage_constraints: Use as an input or output contract exactly as listed in §7.

entries.definition_short: Contracted package with required fields: BOOT_* refs; VERIF_EVENT; VERIF_COUNTER_ANCHOR; export manifest; trust-store refs
entries.definition_operational: Contract rule: Mandatory when policy requires bound verification.
usage_constraints: Use as an input or output contract exactly as listed in §7.

entries.definition_short: Fixes the governing policy under which the verdict is issued.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes. Purpose: Fixes the governing policy under which the verdict is issued.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Proves minimum report completeness.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes for FINALIZE_REPORT. Purpose: Proves minimum report completeness.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Proves export integrity and chain of custody.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes for final output. Purpose: Proves export integrity and chain of custody.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Proves the reversion path.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes for verdict REPLAYABLE. Purpose: Proves the reversion path.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Contracted package with required fields: ledger_uuid; session_id; record stream; policy_profile_id; source_id; hash head / tail; signature refs
entries.definition_operational: Contract rule: Without these fields the agent does not enter replay logic.
usage_constraints: Use as an input or output contract exactly as listed in §7.

entries.definition_short: Proves authenticity and provenance where signatures are policy-required.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes when policy requires signatures. Purpose: Proves authenticity and provenance where signatures are policy-required.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Allows the consumer to replay admissibility and blocking decisions.
entries.definition_operational: Evidence-contract field. Required status: Yes. Purpose: Allows the consumer to replay admissibility and blocking decisions.
usage_constraints: Use only as a field in the minimum evidence set for offline reconstruction and audit.

entries.definition_short: Export integrity requirement for auditable output.
entries.definition_operational: Audit export must preserve chain of custody through exporter identity, covered interval, hashes, CSL head, governing policy, and evidence references used.
usage_constraints: Use only in the public operational sense defined by the specification.

entries.definition_short: Ordering anchor used in policy-sensitive replay and readmission control.
entries.definition_operational: Freshness or anchor values must be strictly increasing under policy; replay or non-increase enters NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD and blocks compliant finalization until restored prerequisites are proven.
usage_constraints: Use only in the public operational sense defined by the specification.

entries.definition_short: Active governing profile used for authority, validation, and policy binding.
entries.definition_operational: Authority source and input element that fixes the governing policy under which the audit is executed and the verdict is issued.
usage_constraints: Use only in the public operational sense defined by the specification.

entries.definition_short: Verification trust input admitted by the specification.
entries.definition_operational: Input element used together with a compatible policy to validate signatures or verification prerequisites where policy requires it.
usage_constraints: Use only in the public operational sense defined by the specification.

entries.definition_short: Policy-based verification input admitted by the specification.
entries.definition_operational: Alternative or companion verification control used in inputs, assumptions, and observability surfaces for signature and evidence validation.
usage_constraints: Use only in the public operational sense defined by the specification.

entries.definition_short: Partial reconstruction is possible but critical insufficiency is absent.
entries.definition_operational: Gate status with permitted actions: Partial report; anomaly export. Prohibited actions: Final verdict REPLAYABLE.
usage_constraints: Use only in gate logic and control-state reasoning.

entries.definition_short: evidence_ok = false or freshness replay detected.
entries.definition_operational: Gate status with permitted actions: Audit-only mode; incident report. Prohibited actions: Checkpoint or report compliant finalization.
usage_constraints: Use only in gate logic and control-state reasoning.

entries.definition_short: Structural and evidence validators have passed.
entries.definition_operational: Gate status with permitted actions: Reconstruction; checkpoint analysis; report assembly. Prohibited actions: None beyond policy.
usage_constraints: Use only in gate logic and control-state reasoning.

entries.definition_short: Unauthorized tool-state or auxiliary artifact detected.
entries.definition_operational: Gate status with permitted actions: Isolated audit; incident export. Prohibited actions: Injection into the replay core.
usage_constraints: Use only in gate logic and control-state reasoning.

entries.definition_short: Named report element referenced for ZSSC-bound sessions.
entries.definition_operational: ZSSC-bound final reports must be able to include or explicitly reference AXIOM_SET as part of the required report content.
usage_constraints: Use only as an attested abbreviation or named control point from the publishable specification.

entries.definition_short: ZSSC control point listed by the specification.
entries.definition_operational: Named auditable governance record or control point supplied by ZSSC and admitted by the public specification.
usage_constraints: Use only as an attested abbreviation or named control point from the publishable specification.

entries.definition_short: ZSSC control point listed by the specification.
entries.definition_operational: Named auditable governance record or control point supplied by ZSSC and admitted by the public specification.
usage_constraints: Use only as an attested abbreviation or named control point from the publishable specification.

entries.definition_short: Foundational model that provides framed record encoding and continuity-related record semantics.
entries.definition_operational: Public operational concept used by the specification for framed record encoding, checksum validation, canonical parsing, append-only hash-chain continuity, fail-closed restoration discipline, tool-state restrictions, and auditable export semantics.
usage_constraints: Use only as a foundational model already assumed by the public specification.

entries.definition_short: Named report element referenced for ZSSC-bound sessions.
entries.definition_operational: ZSSC-bound final reports must be able to include or explicitly reference POLICY_BIND in the required report content.
usage_constraints: Use only as an attested abbreviation or named control point from the publishable specification.

entries.definition_short: Optional evidence or input reference used for counter or anchor verification.
entries.definition_operational: Named verification reference admitted as optional evidence and input-surface content when policy activates bound verification or counter-sensitive ordering.
usage_constraints: Use only as an attested abbreviation or named control point from the publishable specification.

entries.definition_short: Optional evidence or input reference used when policy requires bound verification.
entries.definition_operational: Named verification reference admitted as optional evidence and input-surface content when bound verification is activated by policy.
usage_constraints: Use only as an attested abbreviation or named control point from the publishable specification.

entries.definition_short: Foundational model that provides auditable governance records and control points.
entries.definition_operational: Public operational concept used for governance records and control points such as ZSSC_ENTER, ZSSC_EXIT, CPW_SAMPLE, BAND_CHANGE, CHECKPOINT(LASTCLEAN), ROLLBACK, FAIL_CLOSED, and REPORT.
usage_constraints: Use only for records and control points explicitly admitted by the specification.

entries.definition_short: ZSSC governance record listed by the specification.
entries.definition_operational: Named auditable governance record or control point supplied by ZSSC and admitted by the public specification.
usage_constraints: Use only as an attested abbreviation or named control point from the publishable specification.

entries.definition_short: ZSSC governance record listed by the specification.
entries.definition_operational: Named auditable governance record or control point supplied by ZSSC and admitted by the public specification.
usage_constraints: Use only as an attested abbreviation or named control point from the publishable specification.

entries.definition_short: Implementation optional.
entries.definition_operational: Optionality rule: They must not become the source of truth for admission or audit.
usage_constraints: Use only under the optionality rule stated in §17.

entries.definition_short: Schema optional.
entries.definition_operational: Optionality rule: Recommended when FAIL_CLOSED is related to evidence failure.
usage_constraints: Use only under the optionality rule stated in §17.

entries.definition_short: Controlled optional.
entries.definition_operational: Optionality rule: Use only when policy activates it; it does not replace constitutive verification.
usage_constraints: Use only under the optionality rule stated in §17.

entries.definition_short: Conditional optional.
entries.definition_operational: Optionality rule: Mandatory only when required by the acceptance policy.
usage_constraints: Use only under the optionality rule stated in §17.
